gloss: to devote oneself to; to concentrate on; to dedicate oneself to

definitions.gloss: to devote oneself to; to concentrate on; to dedicate oneself to
definitions.explanation: To focus all of one's effort and attention on a single task, activity, or goal, setting aside other concerns.

examples.japanese: {研究|けんきゅう}に{専念|せんねん}する。
{彼|かれ}は{治療|ちりょう}に{専念|せんねん}するため{仕事|しごと}を{休|やす}んだ。
examples.english: He took time off work to focus on his treatment.

examples.japanese: {子育|こそだ}てに{専念|せんねん}するために{退職|たいしょく}した。
examples.english: She quit her job to devote herself to raising her children.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}は{目|め}の{前|まえ}のことに{専念|せんねん}しよう。
examples.english: Let's focus on what's in front of us right now.

notes:
The pattern is 〜に{専念|せんねん}する. Implies single-minded focus, often requiring the sacrifice or postponement of other activities. Common in news stories about celebrities or athletes stepping away from work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}に{専念|せんねん}する: to devote oneself to work
- {治療|ちりょう}に{専念|せんねん}する: to focus on medical treatment
- {勉強|べんきょう}に{専念|せんねん}する: to concentrate on studying
- {育児|いくじ}に{専念|せんねん}する: to dedicate oneself to childcare
- {本業|ほんぎょう}に{専念|せんねん}する: to focus on one's core business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}する: to concentrate — focuses on mental focus rather than dedicating one's life to something
- {没頭|ぼっとう}する: to be absorbed in — implies being so engrossed that one loses track of surroundings
- {打|う}ち{込|こ}む: to throw oneself into — more casual; emphasizes passionate engagement
